name: Wohnraum - Cafe & Vinothek
kurzbeschreibung: Small, fine design café with wine bar in the heart of Ellmau at the Wilder Kaiser – home accessories, wines, flowers and homemade sweets.
beschreibung:
The Wohnraum – Café & Vinothek is located right in the centre of Ellmau am Wilden Kaiser, at Dorf 48. The small, fine establishment combines a design café with a wine bar and a shop for home accessories, flowers and high-quality gift items.

In the café, guests can enjoy freshly roasted coffee specialities as well as homemade pralines, cakes and macarons. The wine bar is run by wine academic Marie-Christine Chiodo, known as "Die Wein-Marie", who gladly shares her knowledge in wine tastings. A fine selection of wines is offered.

Opening hours are Monday to Saturday from 09:00 to 18:00; on Sundays and public holidays the house remains closed. The Wohnraum is a cosy meeting place for connoisseurs in the Wilder Kaiser region.
